title: The Battle for Fort Sungard (Imperial)
description: Legate Rikke orders the player to assist Imperial soldiers in assaulting and capturing Fort Sungard from Stormcloak rebels in the Reach.

base_facts: I command the Imperial forces at the Reach Imperial Camp.
Fort Sungard must be taken from the Stormcloaks to reclaim the Reach.

QUEST_RECEIVED: I have sent the soldier to join the assault on Fort Sungard.
FORT_TAKEN: Fort Sungard has fallen to Imperial forces. The Reach is ours again.

base_facts: I lead the Imperial war effort in Skyrim.
The Reach was lost to the Stormcloaks and must be retaken.

FORT_TAKEN: Fort Sungard is back in Imperial hands. The soldier performed well.

beats.comment: Player receives orders from Legate Rikke at the Reach Imperial Camp to assist in taking Fort Sungard.
Player joins the Imperial soldiers preparing the assault on Fort Sungard.

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player joins the Imperial soldiers preparing the assault on Fort Sungard.
examples_yes: Tell me what needs to happen next.
examples_no: What are you asking me to do?
No, I do not want to do that.

beats.intent_summary: Player agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player joins the Imperial soldiers preparing the assault on Fort Sungard.

beats.comment: Fort Sungard is captured from the Stormcloaks. Quest completes. Reunification of Skyrim updates.
